headline: Vertex (VRTX) Buys Crinetics To Push Beyond Cystic Fibrosis
summary: Vertex Pharmaceuticals (NasdaqGS:VRTX) has agreed to acquire Crinetics Pharmaceuticals in a deal expected to close in the third quarter of 2026.
